csv_scope_of_work: Construction management at-risk services for construct a new Botanic Garden Conservator. The project will include demolition of an area of the garden and construction of an estimated 4,000 sf barn-style, glass structure. The expected capacity of the new building will be 175 seated occupants for events. The building will consist of a Grand Hall, serving/teaching stations, bride & groom suites, and public restrooms. The facility will be conditioned to allow for year-round use.
